full_text_en:
Hebei Xinkai Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and Gaobeidian Xinkai Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd. v. Honda Motor Co., Ltd. (Japan), Dongfeng Honda Automobile (Wuhan) Co., Ltd., and Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd. — dispute over jurisdiction objection regarding infringement of design patent rights

【Ruling Summary】

(1) For the determination of case jurisdiction, a people's court, at the stage of case filing and acceptance, only conducts a preliminary examination. As long as the relevant evidence formally complies with legal provisions, it may decide to accept the case according to law. However, after accepting a case, if the defendant raises a jurisdiction objection in accordance with the law, the court that accepted the case shall conduct a comprehensive review of the factual basis and legal basis for determining the jurisdiction of the case, including the examination and verification of the relevant evidence.

(2) The provision in Article 2 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Patent Dispute Cases, which states that "first-instance patent dispute cases shall be under the jurisdiction of the intermediate people's courts in the localities of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and such other intermediate people's courts as designated by the Supreme People's Court," is intended to set the minimum level of trial for first-instance patent dispute cases at the intermediate people's court level, and does not exclude the higher people's courts from exercising jurisdiction over first-instance patent dispute cases according to law.

Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court
(2005) Min San Zhong Zi No. 2

Appellants (Defendants at First Instance): Hebei Xinkai Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd., domiciled at South Street, Gaobeidian City, Hebei Province.
Legal representative: Zhang Zhentang, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the company.
Agent ad litem: Wang Jincai, lawyer of Hebei Gaobeidian Jinbei Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Wei Jianhua, Deputy General Manager of the company.

Appellants (Defendants at First Instance): Gaobeidian Xinkai Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 79 South Street, Gaobeidian City, Hebei Province.
Legal representative: Zhang Xiuying, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the company.
Agent ad litem: Wang Jincai, lawyer of Hebei Gaobeidian Jinbei Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Wei Jianhua, Deputy General Manager of the company.

Respondents (Plaintiffs at First Instance): Honda Motor Co., Ltd. (Japan), domiciled at 2-1-1 Minami Aoyama, Minato-ku, Tokyo, Japan.
Legal representative: Oono Michiyoshi (alternative: Hagino Michiyoshi), Chairman of the Board of Directors of the company.
Agent ad litem: Han Dengying, lawyer of Beijing King & Wood Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Zhang Shouzhi, lawyer of Beijing King & Wood Law Firm.

Respondents (Plaintiffs at First Instance): Dongfeng Honda Automobile (Wuhan) Co., Ltd., domiciled at Cheshengdong Road, Wuhan Economic and Technological Development Zone, Wuhan City, Hubei Province.
Legal representative: Zhou Wenjie, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the company.
Agent ad litem: Han Dengying, lawyer of Beijing King & Wood Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Zhang Shouzhi, lawyer of Beijing King & Wood Law Firm.

Defendant at First Instance: Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 232, Datun, Andingmenwai, Chaoyang District, Beijing.
Legal representative: Yu Gang, General Manager of the company.

The appellants Hebei Xinkai Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and Gaobeidian Xinkai Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd., regarding the dispute over jurisdiction objection concerning infringement of design patent rights with the respondents Honda Motor Co., Ltd. (Japan), Dongfeng Honda Automobile (Wuhan) Co., Ltd., and the defendant at first instance Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd., being dissatisfied with the civil ruling (2004) Gao Min Chu Zi No. 1472 of the Beijing High People's Court of the People's Republic of China, jointly filed an appeal to this Court, alleging: 1. Regarding the statement in the original ruling that Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd. sold the allegedly infringing products, the respondents did not provide evidence nor was it subject to cross-examination. 2. The original ruling failed to respond to the appellants' argument raised in the jurisdiction objection that first-instance patent dispute cases should be under the jurisdiction of intermediate people's courts and cannot be under the jurisdiction of a higher people's court; moreover, the provisions of the Beijing High People's Court on the level jurisdiction of first-instance intellectual property civil cases are illegal and contravene Article 2 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Patent Dispute Cases. 3. The appellants have filed a request for a declaration of invalidity of the four patents involved in the case with the Patent Reexamination Board of the State Intellectual Property Office, which has been accepted, and the appellants have also filed an application with the original trial court for a stay of proceedings, requesting that the appellate court consider these matters together in the present case.

The two respondents jointly argued in defense: 1. The defendant at first instance, Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd., sold the allegedly infringing products, so the Beijing courts have jurisdiction over this case. The respondents had already submitted relevant notarized evidence within the time limit for providing evidence at first instance. Since a jurisdiction objection must, according to law, be raised within the time limit for submitting a statement of defense, which occurs before the cross-examination procedure within the time limit for providing evidence, the ruling on the jurisdiction objection could not have been made based on evidence that had already been subject to cross-examination. 2. The provision of the Beijing High People's Court on the level jurisdiction of first-instance intellectual property civil cases was formulated in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law and its judicial interpretations, which stipulate that intellectual property cases with a disputed amount of RMB 100 million or more shall be under the jurisdiction of the higher people's court. Accordingly, the Beijing High People's Court has jurisdiction over this case. 3. The appellants have no right to request that the appellate court review their application for a stay of proceedings filed with the original trial court. 4. The appellants have raised a jurisdiction objection without justifiable reasons, misinterpreted the law, and appealed against the ruling on the jurisdiction objection, with the intention of delaying the proceedings of this case.

The defendant at first instance, Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd., did not submit any opinion on this case.

This Court finds upon trial: The original trial court, on November 30, 2004, when serving the plaintiffs' statement of complaint on the two appellants, also served them with the 16 pieces of evidence submitted by the two respondents at the time of filing the complaint, including Evidence 7 (Notarial Certificate (2004) Jing Zheng Jing Zi No. 05752 of Beijing Notary Public Office) and Evidence 8 (Notarial Certificate (2004) Jing Zheng Jing Zi No. 05753 of Beijing Notary Public Office), which were used to prove that Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd. sold the allegedly infringing products, i.e., automobiles of brand and model HXK6491E. At the second instance, the two appellants acknowledged receipt of the above evidence but refused to provide further opinions on cross-examination on the ground that the notary public officers had not appeared in court.

It is also found that the two appellants jointly raised an objection to the jurisdiction of this case during the time limit for submitting a statement of defense at first instance, on the following grounds: 1. The allegedly infringing product, i.e., the automobile of model HXK6491E, was manufactured by Hebei Xinkai Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd., whose domicile is in Hebei Province. According to relevant judicial interpretations, this case should be under the jurisdiction of the Shijiazhuang Intermediate People's Court of Hebei Province. 2. According to the relevant provisions of judicial interpretations, first-instance patent dispute cases shall be under the jurisdiction of intermediate people's courts, and it is inappropriate for the Beijing High People's Court to accept this case. The appellants did not address the issue of whether Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd. was the seller of the allegedly infringing products in their jurisdiction objection.

This Court holds:

(1) Regarding the basis for determining the territorial jurisdiction of this case, i.e., whether Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd. is the seller of the allegedly infringing products in this case. For the determination of case jurisdiction, the court, at the stage of case filing and acceptance, only conducts a preliminary examination. As long as the relevant evidence formally complies with legal provisions, it may decide to accept the case according to law. However, after the case is accepted and the defendant raises a jurisdiction objection according to law, the court that accepted the case shall conduct a comprehensive review of the factual basis and legal basis for determining the jurisdiction of the case, including the examination and verification of the relevant evidence.

In this case, whether Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd. is the seller of the allegedly infringing products involves the issue of the factual basis for determining whether the original trial court has territorial jurisdiction over this case. The original trial court's failure to assemble the parties to examine and verify the relevant evidence was somewhat improper. However, given that the defendant did not raise this as the factual and legal basis for its jurisdiction objection, the original trial court's ruling made solely on the facts and reasons raised in the objection does not constitute a substantive error.

During the second instance, this Court assembled the parties to investigate this factual issue. On one hand, the two appellants, on the ground that the notary public officers had not appeared in court, refused to provide further opinions on cross-examination regarding the notarized documents submitted by the two respondents to prove that Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd. was the seller of the allegedly infringing products; on the other hand, they explicitly stated that they had no evidence to submit. The two appellants' reasons for not recognizing the relevant notarized documents are insufficient and lack legal basis, and they shall be deemed to have waived their right to further cross-examine this evidence. Pursuant to Article 67 of the Civil Procedure Law and Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph (6) and Paragraph 2 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Evidence in Civil Proceedings, when there is no evidence to the contrary sufficient to overturn the notarized proof, the people's court shall take the facts notarized through legal procedures as evidence for determining the facts of the case.

Therefore, this Court determines that the notarized documents submitted by the respondents can prove that Beijing Xinsheng Baili Automobile Trade Co., Ltd. is the seller of the allegedly infringing products in this case. Pursuant to Article 6 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Patent Dispute Cases, which states that "if a manufacturer and a seller are jointly sued, the people's court of the place where the seller is located has jurisdiction," as the location of the seller of the allegedly infringing products, the relevant courts in Beijing have territorial jurisdiction over this case. Although part of the abovementioned grounds of appeal raised by the two appellants is valid, it is not sufficient to alter the territorial jurisdiction over this case. The respondents' defense argument that a ruling on a jurisdiction objection cannot be made based on evidence that has been subject to cross-examination is also not valid and does not affect this Court's determination of jurisdiction over this case.

(2) Whether the Beijing High People's Court's exercise of level jurisdiction over this case is illegal. Article 2 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Patent Dispute Cases provides: "First-instance patent dispute cases shall be under the jurisdiction of the intermediate people's courts in the localities of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and such other intermediate people's courts as designated by the Supreme People's Court." The purpose of this provision is that the minimum level of trial for patent dispute cases should be these designated intermediate people's courts, and it does not exclude higher people's courts from exercising jurisdiction over first-instance patent dispute cases according to law. The Provisions on the Level Jurisdiction of First-Instance Intellectual Property Civil Dispute Cases Accepted by the People's Courts at All Levels in Beijing, formulated by the Beijing High People's Court on December 17, 2002, stipulate that intellectual property civil dispute cases (including foreign-related cases) with a disputed amount of RMB 100 million or more shall be under the jurisdiction of the higher people's court. The content of this provision complies with the Civil Procedure Law and the relevant judicial interpretations of this Court and can serve as the basis for determining the level jurisdiction over this case. The plaintiffs' claim for compensation in this case is RMB 100 million, and the Beijing High People's Court has level jurisdiction over this case. The appellants' grounds of appeal that a higher people's court cannot have jurisdiction over first-instance patent dispute cases and that the provisions formulated by the Beijing High People's Court on the level jurisdiction of first-instance intellectual property civil cases are illegal cannot be upheld. However, the original trial court's failure to evaluate this ground of jurisdiction objection raised by the two appellants is also a deficiency.

(3) Whether the request for a stay of proceedings raised by the two appellants should be considered. The determination of jurisdiction is a prerequisite for the court to deal with other procedural issues and all substantive issues in the case. Only after the issue of jurisdiction objection is resolved does the trial court need to examine and decide whether to stay the proceedings and other matters. As an appeal case dealing with a jurisdiction objection, the issue of staying the proceedings is not within the scope of trial of this case, and this Court will not examine it.

Furthermore, regarding the respondents' opinion that the two appellants raised an unfounded jurisdiction objection to delay the proceedings of this case, since the two appellants are exercising their litigation rights according to law, this is also unrelated to the trial of this case, and this Court does not support it.

In summary, the main grounds of appeal of the appellants are not valid. Pursuant to Article 153, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph (1) and Article 154 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, this Court rules as follows:

The appeal is dismissed and the original ruling is affirmed.

This ruling is final.

Presiding Judge: Wang Yongchang
Acting Judge: He Zhonglin
